title: Vilvah Milk Drops serum: what is in it, 20ml or 40ml, and is it worth it?
body:
Quick answer: Vilvah Milk Drops is a light, water-based gel serum with eleven ingredients, led by aloe vera juice, betaine, glycerin and hyaluronic acid, plus alpha arbutin, a brown seaweed extract and rice milk extract. The milk in the name is rice milk extract: there is no dairy in the list. It comes in 20ml (£21.99, about £1.10 per ml) and 40ml (£30.99, about £0.77 per ml), so the 40ml is the better value if you use it daily.

What is in Vilvah Milk Drops?

The full ingredient list, in pack order:

  1. Aqua (water): the base of the gel.
  2. Aloe vera juice: a watery plant juice that gives a light, cool feel.
  3. Betaine: from sugar beet, it helps skin feel moisturised.
  4. Glycerin: a humectant that draws water into the skin's surface.
  5. Xanthan gum: thickens the serum into a gel.
  6. Hyaluronic acid: holds water, so skin feels plump and hydrated.
  7. Caprylic/capric triglyceride: a light, coconut-derived emollient.
  8. Cystoseira tamariscifolia extract: a brown seaweed extract.
  9. Alpha arbutin: a stable form of arbutin, a molecule found in plants such as bearberry.
  10. Rice milk extract: the milk in Milk Drops.
  11. Sodium benzoate and potassium sorbate: the preservatives.

Things the list does not contain: added fragrance, essential oils, alcohol, silicones or oils beyond the light triglyceride, and no animal-derived ingredients.

Is Milk Drops a brightening serum?

Vilvah names it a brightening serum, and you will see that word on packs and online. We describe what is in it rather than promise a result: day to day it works as a lightweight, hydrating layer that sits well under moisturiser and makeup. We cannot promise any change to dark spots or skin tone. If a patch of pigmentation is new, changing or worrying you, show it to a pharmacist or your GP, and whatever serum you use, daily sunscreen is the step that matters most.

20ml or 40ml: which size?

  • 20ml (£21.99): a good size to try it, or for travel.
  • 40ml (£30.99): about £0.77 per ml against £1.10 for the 20ml, and less than two 20ml bottles (£43.98).

At two to three drops morning and night, either size lasts a good while. Both are the same formula.

How to use Milk Drops

  1. Cleanse: Vilvah Fragrance-Free Cream Face Wash (£9.99) or the powder-to-foam Milk Powder Face Wash (£13.99).
  2. Tone if you like: Vilvah Milk Face Toner (£19.99) contains glycolic acid, so start it every other day.
  3. Press two or three drops of Milk Drops over the face and neck.
  4. Moisturise: Vilvah Ultra Moisturising Cream (£25.99) or your usual cream.
  5. In the morning, finish with sunscreen such as Vilvah Skin Finish Sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++ (£17.99).

Our face serum guide explains layering serums, and our toner guide and moisturiser guide help you choose the steps around it. Patch test before first use.

Milk Drops or Vilvah Better Ageing Serum?

  • Milk Drops: water-based gel; aloe, hyaluronic acid, alpha arbutin, rice milk extract. Light, for morning and evening.
  • Better Ageing Serum (£28.99, 20ml): a silkier serum with bakuchiol, niacinamide, ceramides, hyaluronic acid, pomegranate seed oil and olive squalane. Vilvah suggests it for evenings.

Many people use both: Milk Drops in the morning and Better Ageing at night. The Vilvah AM PM Serum Kit (£46.99) boxes the two together.

Kits with Milk Drops

  • Vilvah Milk Face Kit (£44.99): Milk Drops with the Milk Mud Mask, a kaolin clay mask with oat milk and saffron extracts.
  • Vilvah Skin Hydration Kit (£45.99): Milk Drops with the Milk Face Toner.
  • Vilvah AM PM Serum Kit (£46.99): Milk Drops with Better Ageing Serum.

Is Vilvah Milk Drops worth it?

It is worth it if you want a light, fragrance-free hydrating serum with a short list that layers easily under other products. Skip it if you want a rich, oily texture (choose Better Ageing) or a vitamin C serum (see our face serum guide). Real customer reviews appear on the product page; we do not publish invented ones.

Buying Vilvah in the UK

Swansura is an official UK partner of Vilvah, so every bottle is genuine and ships from UK stock with no import charge on delivery. UK delivery is free over £40. New to the brand? Read Vilvah in the UK, compare it with Deyga in Deyga or Vilvah, or shop all Vilvah and every face serum.
